subject: ela
intro: Pick the theme or objective summary.

items.prompt:
Read.

Despite being mocked, Ravi kept inventing until his design worked.

The theme is:
A) give up easily
B) persistence pays off
C) inventing is boring

An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) includes your opinion
B) states key events without opinion
C) is very long
items.answer: B) states key events without opinion

solution.answer: B) states key events without opinion

items.prompt:
A theme is usually a statement about:
A) life or people
B) the page count
C) the font

Read.

Kim refused help and failed twice, then accepted her teammates' help and succeeded.

The theme is:
A) always work alone
B) accepting help and teamwork lead to success
C) failure is final
items.answer: B) accepting help and teamwork lead to success

steps: Her change shows the theme. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) accepting help and teamwork lead to success

items.prompt:
Which is an OBJECTIVE summary?
A) Kim stubbornly refused help, which was foolish, but then wisely accepted it.
B) Kim first refused help and failed, then accepted help and succeeded.
C) This is the best story ever.
items.answer: B) Kim first refused help and failed, then accepted help and succeeded.

steps: No opinion words. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Kim first refused help and failed, then accepted help and succeeded.

items.prompt:
A theme DEVELOPS:
A) only in the last sentence
B) gradually, through events and characters' choices
C) never
items.answer: B) gradually, through events and characters' choices

steps: Over the whole text. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) gradually, through events and characters' choices

items.prompt:
Read.

The miser spent his life hoarding gold and trusting no one. He died alone, with no friends to mourn him.

The BEST theme statement is:
A) Saving money guarantees happiness.
B) Greed and distrust lead to a lonely life.
C) Gold is valuable.
items.answer: B) Greed and distrust lead to a lonely life.

steps: His choices caused his isolation. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Greed and distrust lead to a lonely life.

items.prompt:
Which sentence would NOT belong in an objective summary?
A) The hero rescued the villagers.
B) The hero bravely and heroically saved everyone, which was amazing.
C) The hero then returned home.
items.answer: B) The hero bravely and heroically saved everyone, which was amazing.

solution.answer: B) The hero bravely and heroically saved everyone, which was amazing.
